composio.note: Composio manages the Todoist OAuth app. A separate Todoist MCP toolkit requires your own OAuth app.

need_own_app.answer: Not for prototypes, since Composio's managed app works. For production you will likely want your own app so users see your name instead of Composio, and to get dedicated quota and your own scopes.
reasons: Consent screen shows your brand, not Composio
Dedicated quota instead of quota shared across Composio users
Shorter trigger polling than the 15-minute managed minimum

prerequisites.title: Verified Todoist account
prerequisites.detail: Certification starts with a verified Todoist user account. Todoist can help with a Pro account for development if needed.

prerequisites.title: HTTPS redirect URLs
prerequisites.detail: Redirect URIs must be configured in the App Management Console and use HTTPS (localhost is allowed for testing).

steps.title: Create app in App Management Console
steps.detail: Log in, create the app and add valid OAuth2 redirect URLs. Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.
steps.done_when: You have a client ID and client secret.

steps.title: Choose minimal scopes
steps.detail: Pick the narrowest scopes, for example data:read or task:add, rather than data:read_write.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the Todoist auth config through Composio's API with your client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: Auth config exists and a test connection works.

steps.title: Prepare listing assets and copy
steps.detail: Draft the English marketing text, installation instructions, a 250x250 icon and 1600x1000 screenshots spec, plus the disclaimer and a demo script.

steps.title: Record demo and submit
steps.detail: Record the demo video and submit the certification form with HTTPS links.

steps.title: Wait for certification review
steps.detail: Todoist aims to respond within ten business days.
steps.done_when: Listing is published with a public link.

traps.title: Dynamic client registration returns a client secret that does
traps.detail: Dynamic client registration returns a client secret that does not expire.

traps.title: Token limit blocks authorization
traps.detail: If your app exceeds the maximum token limit or is suspended, users get invalid_application_status when authorizing. The limit's value was not found.

traps.title: Unconfigured redirect URI errors
traps.detail: A redirect URI not configured in the console causes an error, and redirect_uri is required if you configure several.

traps.title: Naming and disclaimer rules
traps.detail: Todoist cannot be the primary app name, and the description must say it is not created by or affiliated with Todoist.

traps.title: Restricted scopes rejected
traps.detail: Scopes restricted to first-party use are rejected during registration.

blockers.what_it_means: The app exceeded the maximum token limit or was suspended for abuse.
blockers.what_to_do: Contact Todoist; the limit is not documented in the dossier.

blockers.symptom: Certification rejected for duplicating Todoist or using only Zapier/IFTTT
blockers.what_it_means: Listings must complement Todoist and integrate directly.
blockers.what_to_do: Adjust the integration or skip the listing, which is optional.
blockers.agent_can_help: Review the listing against the criteria.
